camel_example: aliyun vod DescribeVodDomainQpsData --region cn-hangzhou --IspNameEn unicom --EndTime '2024-05-02T15:59:00Z' --DomainName 'example.com' --LocationNameEn beijing --StartTime '2024-05-02T15:50:00Z' --Interval 300
description_en: Queries the queries per second (QPS) of accelerated domain names at a 5-minute granularity. Data from the last 90 days is supported
description_zh: 获取5分钟计算粒度加速域名的每秒访问次数QPS，支持获取最近90天的数据
kebab_example: aliyun vod describe-vod-domain-qps-data --domain-name example.com --start-time 2024-05-02T15:50:00Z --end-time 2024-05-02T15:59:00Z --interval 300 --isp-name-en unicom --location-name-en beijing --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVodDomainQpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain names. Separate multiple domain names with commas (,). You can specify up to 500 domain names in a single request.

By default, all accelerated domain names are queried
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔，一次最多支持 500 个域名查询。

默认查询所有加速域名

parameters.name: end_time
